In an ideal world, relationships would be based on genuine care, affection, and commitment, but it is essential to recognize the reality in which women live. It is up to society to address and rectify the root causes of these systemic inequalities while understanding that women deserve the ability to make choices that lead to their own empowerment and well-being.
